title: Text Morph
description: Text and numbers that morph in place when they change: shared characters glide to their new spots, the rest fade, digits roll by place value. No dependencies.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to show. Change it to morph. A lone number keeps its type, so `locale` and `decimals` can format it. React elements are refused.

props.name: duration
props.description: Morph length in milliseconds. Ignored when `ease` is a spring.

props.name: ease
props.type: string | { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number; precision?: number }
props.description: A CSS easing, or spring parameters (the duration then follows the spring).

props.name: numbers
props.description: Morph numeric words by place value. Off falls back to the character morph.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for word segmentation and number formatting.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits for a numeric value. Ignored for strings.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale characters as they enter and leave.

props.name: cursorIndex
props.description: Caret position for a single number being typed: digits match by caret instead of by place.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Swap the text without motion when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the morph off and swap text instantly.

props.name: onAnimationStart / onAnimationComplete
props.description: Called when a morph starts and when it settles.

a11y: The value is kept once as plain, visually clipped text for screen readers; the animated character fragments are aria-hidden, so a morph is read as one word, not letter by letter.
With the default respectReducedMotion, the text swaps without motion when the user prefers reduced motion.
It renders inline text with no role of its own; to announce changes, wrap it in a live region (for example aria-live="polite").
docs:
Installed `TextMorph` (`@/components/ui/text-morph`) and its engine (`@/lib/text-morph-engine`, `@/lib/text-morph-text`, `@/lib/text-morph-core`).

```tsx
import { TextMorph } from "@/components/ui/text-morph";

<TextMorph>{label}</TextMorph>
<TextMorph decimals={2}>{price}</TextMorph>
```

Change the children to morph. Pass text or numbers only. `useTextMorph()` gives the same engine for an element you render yourself. The motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion` by default.
